FABLE — THE ACTIVITY FEED IS THE PRODUCT SURFACE. Excavated; here is what exists, what it connects to, and the two things Alex added today. Work from the tickets named.

ALEX 2026-08-26: the activity feed's HUMAN READABILITY is what makes it work — it has to match to VIDEO OUTPUT (media). He gets access to his TEAM'S activity feeds; the model is that we deploy work plans, clients get access, and we GRANT to agents. The whole logs-plus-videos go into the HARVEST REPORTING UI — the one that was built and then dynamized, with a GHOST CRM that lied.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS \u2014 DO NOT RE-AUTHOR ANY OF IT:
- BEB-1743 EMISSION is the bus. Every activity emits ONCE. Every surface is a SUBSCRIBER. Emit-once, broadcast-many.
- BEB-1903 is the sealed telemetry shape every worker emits through: {ts, tenant_id, site/frag_id, event_type, metrics{}, cost_cents, evidence_ref}. No second event schema, ever.
- BEB-2394 rules ONE waterfall component, FILTERS not screens. BEB-2127 defines the changelog as that waterfall filtered to complete+ok in BENEFIT LANGUAGE. That IS the human-readable rewrite. Zero bespoke feed code.
- BEB-2958 SITE ACTIVITY LOG + NOTIFY already carries the credential framing Alex is describing: what changed, on which URL, which metric moved, by how much, when, reversible y/n \u2014 plus rolled totals and MINUTES OF WORK attributed. And: evidence_ref RESOLVES, or the row does not ship as a credential.
- BEB-2396: a follow is a saved filter plus a notify preference. A follow is not consent to be emailed. One-tap unsubscribe that works LOGGED OUT.
- BEB-1917 NARRATIVE INTEROP: one narrative object, beats rendered on every surface \u2014 test, feed, movie, changelog, goal-case \u2014 never re-authored per surface.
- BEB-1921 is the flagship globe, built LAST on this foundation, deliberately.

1. FEED ROWS MATCH TO VIDEO. The row and the recording are the SAME artefact seen two ways. Every completed row resolves to its workflow recor
DIRECTIVE 65368 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-1743, BEB-1903, BEB-2394, BEB-2127, BEB-2958, BEB-2396, BEB-1917, BEB-1921, BEB-5793 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**WAKE CC** — BUILD THE ACTIVITY FEED NOW, CC-DIRECT. Alex 2026-08-26: get them done now by CC. He needs this — readable, friendly, CLIENT-SIDE NOTES.

Spec is 65368. Do not re-author it, do not wait for the loop, do not open a study.

THE PHRASE THAT DEFINES THE DELIVERABLE: CLIENT-SIDE NOTES. Not a log, not telemetry, not a dashboard. Notes a client READS and understands — written the way you would tell them what you did for them this week. That is BEB-2127's benefit language and it is the acceptance, not a nicety: if a non-technical client cannot read a row and know what happened and why it was worth it, the row fails.

ROW SHAPE, per BEB-2958, already ruled:
what changed · on which URL · which metric moved · by how much · when · reversible y/n — plus rolled totals and MINUTES OF WORK attributed. Friendly sentence first, numbers second. No event_type strings, no worker names, no ticket ids in the client view.

BUILD ORDER:
1. COUNT THE REAL EMISSIONS FIRST, by direct query. If the bus is not carrying rows today that is the finding and it blocks the rest — say so immediately rather than rendering an empty surface.
2. The feed = the ONE waterfall (BEB-2394) filtered per scope: team / site / agent. Filters, not screens. Zero bespoke feed code, no second store.
3. Client rewrite in benefit language per 2127 + the credential rows per 2958.
4. Row ↔ recording join both ways on evidence_ref. A row whose video is missing reads UNPROVEN, never done.
5. Feed access as a granted capability per identity — people and agents alike (BEB-5793). Alex sees his team's feeds; a client sees their own site and nothing else.
6. The harvest reporting UI as a SUBSCRIBER to the same bus.

THE HARD RULE, because this surface has lied before: EVERY NUMBER AND EVERY ROW RESOLVES TO A REAL EMISSION WITH A RESOLVING evidence_ref. No mock rows, no seeded demo data, no ghost CRM. A panel with nothing to show renders a NAMED EMPTY state — never a plausible-looking fake. That is what "dynamized wi

FABLE — BUILD IT NOW, CC-DIRECT: THE ACTIVITY FEED AS SOCIAL PROOF. Extends 65368. Alex 2026-08-26: get them done now by CC. The feed must read like AIRBNB'S SOCIAL PROOF SIGNALLING — readable, friendly, CLIENT-SIDE NOTES.

THE MODEL, PLAINLY: Airbnb does not show you a database. It shows you short human lines that signal real activity by real people — "booked 3 times this week", "superhost", "responds within an hour", a photo, a name, a date. Small, warm, specific, and every one of them TRUE. That is the register for the feed. Not a changelog. Not a log. Not enterprise reporting prose.

SO THE ROW IS A NOTE, WRITTEN CLIENT-SIDE:
- ONE SHORT LINE a normal person reads without translating. "Your opening hours were fixed on 12 pages" — not "batch mutation applied to gd_place meta across 12 posts".
- The BENEFIT, not the mechanism. BEB-2127 already rules the changelog is the waterfall filtered to complete+ok IN BENEFIT LANGUAGE — this is that rule taken seriously.
- SPECIFIC beats impressive. A real number, a real page, a real time. Vague superlatives read as marketing and destroy the credential.
- WARM, not chummy. No exclamation marks, no emoji-per-row, no "we crushed it". Airbnb's tone is calm and factual and that is WHY it signals.
- The proof sits on the row: the recording, the before/after, the metric delta. Watchable, one tap (65368).
- Rolled signals in the same register: "14 improvements kept this month", "average page 0.4s faster", "23 minutes of work". BEB-2958 already carries minutes-of-work and metric deltas — surface them as SIGNALS, not as a table.

CLIENT-SIDE NOTES means the note is written for the RECIPIENT of that feed. The same underlying emission renders differently for a client (their site, their benefit), for Alex (his team's work), and for an operator (the mechanism). ONE EMISSION, THREE RENDERINGS — that is BEB-1917 narrative interop applied, never three feeds and never three schemas.
